scientific_queries.note: Re-tests R87's null result with a dose-aware additive null model.

subagent_note: None dispatched: the round suspects its own previous null model rather than the resource, and is proved right.

correction_to_R87.R87_claim: the additivity residual is noise (CV R2 = -0.034) and BATCHIE cannot test the question
correction_to_R87.actual_fault: R87 averaged every (pair, dose) well into one value per pair and gave each drug a single effect, so the negative R2 measured a weak null model rather than an unlearnable residual
correction_to_R87.evidence: adding per-drug log-dose slopes raises the null's cross-validated R2 from -0.034 to +0.651
correction_to_R87.consequence: BATCHIE can discriminate on the residual arm; R87's resource verdict was wrong there

wording_discipline: the pre-registered H226 only licensed 'not significantly better than random'; the point estimate is +2.81 pp, so calling it a loss would overstate the evidence. The verdict string was changed from annotation_loses... to no_established_gain...

relation_to_gdsc.GDSC_C45: the annotation model loses to a two-way additive baseline by 10.12 pp on the leakage-free unseen-combination pool
relation_to_gdsc.BATCHIE_R88: the annotation model is +2.81 pp over random but not established, and marginals are blind in this arena
relation_to_gdsc.conclusion: the two resources cannot validate one another, but neither supports the annotation model having decision value

limits: 48 units from 11 cells is underpowered, which is the binding limitation of this round
each drug has only a few concentration points, so slope estimates are unstable
residuals may still be dominated by well-level noise
retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim; no meta-learning or RSI
next_gates: increase the number of held-out units (more repeats or pooled layouts) to raise power

register_updates.C61: new: no established annotation gain on dose-aware residuals
